class.name: ImpostorMaterial
class.brief_description: Draws an Impostor as a quad turned to the camera.
class.description: The material of [method Impostor.get_mesh]: it turns its quad to the camera, shows the view baked nearest the camera's direction, and lights it as a rounded shape, as a tree's crown is. It turns to the light when drawing shadows, so it casts a shadow of the right shape. [Impostor] sets it up.

members.member: Where the texture's alpha is below this, nothing is drawn.
